svg.title: Sidecar / Who the UI API Trusts
svg.desc: Four boundaries decide trust: your Unix socket, the loopback port every page can reach, the tailnet behind tailscaled, and SSH for the phone and remote owners.. Solid colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members; dotted outlines mark collapsed elements that contain members. Neither is an inferred trust envelope.
